newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Chemical completes E/M sale.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Chemical completes E/M sale.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp said on Tuesday that it completed the sale of certain assets of its E/M Corp subsidiary to MCP Acquisition Corp for cash and other considerations.
MCP is a subsidiary of Morgan Crucible Co Plc, a multinational manufacturing and marketing company.
It said E/M's engineered surface treatment technology holds promise, but does not meet Great Lakes' criteria for a core business.
"Completing this divestiture will allow the company to focus on the growth opportunities afforded us in our worldwide specialty chemicals business," said chief executive officer Robert McDonald.
E/M develops engineered surface treatments, a business that in 1995 generated about $30 million in revenues, or roughly one percent of Great Lakes' annual sales.
